name: Sid Jacobson JCC Mah Jongg
description: Sid Jacobson JCC (East Hills, Long Island; NYC metro) runs beginner Mah Jongg classes taught by Audrey Kurland and a Thursday clinic. Its class page says: 'the official National Mah Jongg League rules' and 'The 2026 National Mah Jongg League card' is required (sold at first class for $15). Also Members Only Open Play on Mondays. Fall 2026 beginner series were full as of 2026-11-13.
address: Sid Jacobson JCC, East Hills, NY
schedule: Beginner Mondays 10am-12:30pm (Oct 19-Dec 14 2026); Beginner Tuesdays 7-9:30pm (Oct 13-Dec 8 2026); Beginner Thursdays 4-6:30pm (Oct 15-Dec 10 2026); Clinic Thursdays 10am-12:30pm (Oct 15-Dec 10 2026); Members Only Open Play Mondays 12:30-2:30pm (Sep 14 2026-Jun 28 2027). Series fee $225 members / $300 nonmembers (8 sessions)

name: JCC Rockland (Lewis JCC) Game Time

address: 450 West Nyack Road, West Nyack, NY 10994
schedule: Open Play Mon-Fri 12-4pm; Beginner Mahjong with Lisa Thursdays 10am-12pm (Nov 5-Dec 17 2026, no class Nov 26), members $160 / public $175 (price basis unclear)
